% ==================================================================
%  Parity from the traces of the two harnessed vehicles -- one sigconf text
%  width (8.2 cm), pdfLaTeX, plain TikZ (no pgfplots; coordinates are embedded)
%  Data:      the state lines of the recorded course flight (sim/out/lean-course-1ms/inputs.txt,
%             7797 ticks, the 1 m/s figure-eight course with the tuned gains) replayed by the
%             script through copter_lean (lean/.lake/build/bin) and copter_ref
%             (build/vehicle) with --exact --trace --bits and the course parameter files:
%             per tick the 4 actuators and the 18 trace numbers (position, velocity and
%             acceleration targets, thrust vector, attitude-target Euler angles, body-rate
%             targets) with their bit patterns. The replayed actuators equal the flown
%             ones (motors.txt).
%  Top:       the north position target, the roll attitude target and actuator m1 of
%             both vehicles (copter_ref pale and wide under copter_lean), thinned to
%             400 points each (largest-triangle-three-buckets).
%  Middle:    per value and tick, the number of bits that differ between the two
%             vehicles (popcount of the XOR of the bit patterns), the maximum over bins
%             of 20 ticks: 0 of 22 x 7797 = 171534 values differ; the largest count is 0.
%             Equal runs of cells are merged into one rectangle per row.
%  Bottom:    contrast: the same state lines through a mutated Lean vehicle, built
%             separately in cpp2lean build/mutated/lean from a copy of lean/ with
%             AC_Attitude_lib.lean edited as the CPP2LEAN_MUTATE sensitivity check
%             does: single-precision sinf/cosf of 0.5f*theta in
%             Quaternion::from_axis_angle (2 replacements); per tick the number of the
%             22 values that differ from copter_ref: first at tick 541 (t = 1.3525 s,
%             p_t, r_t), first actuator at tick 1295 (t = 3.2375 s);
%             6501 of 7797 ticks differ in some value.
%  Generated by cpp2lean sim/figs/make_parity_trace.py; no hand-edited coordinates.
% ==================================================================
